commitments.commitment: Zero-shot evaluation of **all** models on the secondary dataset; compare attention maps with visible symptoms
commitments.document_status: ✅ Done 2026-11-21. First half: all 130 round-models (11 headline methods and 9 Stage 5 conditions, 5 rounds each) scored zero-shot on Paddy Doctor, `docs/reports/paddy_report.md`; H3 not shown. The comparison of attention maps with visible symptoms (Stage 12, 2026-11-21, `docs/reports/explain_report.md`): 50 blind heat maps rated by three disclosed model raters, yes 39.3%, partly 32.0%, no 28.7%, all agree on 88.0% (Fleiss' kappa 0.88); deletion test on test photos shows the attended tiles matter (gap 25.4 points at k=16, both ranges); on Paddy photos the effect is small (2.2 points, photo range only). Second half done with model raters (set 1). A second set of three agent ratings (set 2) was imported on 2026-11-21 under the importer's kind label `human` (Ahsan's decision; `docs/reports/heatmap_ratings_report.md`: yes 49.3%, partly 24.0%, no 26.7%, all agree 76.0%, kappa 0.75; majority equals the model majority on 84.0% of maps); **no person has rated the maps**, so write both sets as model ratings ("Model raters, set 1" and "set 2", as in `final_explain_ratings`) **Paper verdict (2026-11-22): met (H3 not shown)**: both evaluations were run; H3 not being shown is a result.
